definitions.text: A carriage pulled by two or more draught animals (generally draught horses) harnessed one behind the other, both providing pulling power but only the animal in front being able to steer. .mw-parser-output .defdate{font-size:smaller}
Two draught animals (generally draught horses) harnessed one behind the other. A thing with two components arranged one behind the other.
examples: If you want a canoe that can seat both of you comfortably, you’ll need a tandem.
